title: Onboarding spritemap + annotated overlay screenshots for template apps
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a cohesive set of visual assets and annotated README diagrams for the template app quickstart flows. Deliverables include: a spritemap of hero/reference screenshots (desktop, tablet, mobile), annotated overlay PNGs showing where to click and what state is expected, lightweight sequence diagrams for README (API key → client init → first response), alt-text and accessibility notes for each image, and dark-mode variants. These assets will be used in the public docs quickstart, reference app README, and the Console first-run modal.
acceptance_criteria: Sprite and individual exported screenshots (PNG + SVG) for desktop/tablet/mobile exist in Drive and are linked in the README
Each screenshot has an annotated overlay version with numbered callouts and short microcopy explaining the step
Sequence diagrams (PNG + text-based Mermaid) for README covering: generate API key → set env → call /v1/generate → stream response
Alt text and simple accessibility checklist present for every image
Design review approved by PM and Engineering; assets merged to docs repo and referenced in the template-app README (GitHub PR)
Dark-mode variants included and verified at 320px, 768px, and 1440px breakpoints
tasks: Stage 1: Audit existing reference screenshots in Drive and previous starter kit assets
Stage 2: Create new high-fidelity spritemap (4 hero shots + 6 breakpoint variants)
Stage 3: Produce annotated overlays with numbered callouts and component-level labels
Stage 4: Export assets (PNG@2x, SVGs where possible) and upload to shared Drive folder
Stage 5: Create Mermaid sequence and embed into README; add plain-text fallback for the docsite
Stage 6: Write alt text and small accessibility guidance doc
Stage 7: Open GitHub PR to docs repo referencing assets and include sample screenshot usage in README
Stage 8: Collect engineering review fixes and finalize assets
